name: Wrecker Helmet Payback
description:
Favored by the most brutal of hunters, the Wrecker armor is a fusion of discarded metal and pilfered fabric cobbled together to offer protection while stalking prey. It features an intimidating and enclosed helmet with four eye-like red sensors to keep the wearer connected to the world around them.

The Payback version is sprayed with red paint and anointed with bone fragments and Vanduul armor pieces.
